directives.intent: Keep at least 600 energy credits banked. Reserves compound and buy options later; a treasury spent to nothing cannot act on an opportunity at all.
directives.rationale: Measured on this exact save (na-6db, 40 turns): the brain spent the treasury from 632 down to ~130 by turn 111 with 54 rush-buys and never recovered, ending 2353 credits and 2 bases behind the deterministic baseline. Its energy INCOME finished 5/turn lower, so the spending bought a permanently smaller economy rather than a temporary dip.
